The '''minor rim leagues''' were a level of [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] below the major leagues. Low-level and amateur [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] pilots might start their career in the minor rim leagues. The [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]] [[Mars Guo/Legends|Mars Guo]] began in such leagues before moving up for the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].
